description: Visually verified missed animals (animal) and uncertain objects (uncertain) on CAC train-split images; boxes x1,y1,x2,y2 full-res px + candidate conf. Candidates: union of the production detector at conf>=0.25 on 1280 and 640 tiles not matching an annotation box (IoU<0.3) and not >=80% inside another box, dark context only (grid paper/ruler/rim candidates with median context grey >110 were all non-animals in a 70/70 check). Holdout images and CAC_PDF_Ctrl_2_002 are not included.
